title: 76% of SMB owners are automating work. The next step is making sure they're doing it safely.
summary: If you're a business owner, you already know how helpful AI can be. It has risks, too, but you can avoid them by creating clear guidelines on how to use AI.
body_markdown: AI governance defines the standards for compliance and risk management.[Human-in-the-loop (HITL)](https://zapier.com/blog/human-in-the-loop/) puts these principles into practice by embedding mandatory human checkpoints directly into your AI or automated workflows.
